verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, and automated GL coding, which covers the coding and routing-for-payment parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows invoices being matched to purchase orders, and the claims are brief marketing lines without detailed docs or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching (two- or three-way), detailed first-party bill-pay workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the invoice automation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: Save time with AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments.
automate GL coding by entity globally
